seo.title: Project Assurance: Remote Project Monitoring & Progress Reports | YFP Assurance
seo.description: Remote project monitoring and video-based progress reports for property, interiors, hospitality, automotive and marine projects, with project coordination where separately contracted.

hero.title: Know What’s Happening. Even When You’re Not There.
hero.lead: Structured remote project monitoring and evidence documentation, plus project coordination where it is separately contracted, for owners who cannot be on site every day.

categories.title: Visibility across four project types.
categories.text: Whether it is a villa renovation, a restaurant refurbishment, a classic car restoration or a yacht refit, you receive organised evidence of what has actually been done.

items.title: Property & Interiors
items.text: Home renovations, interior fit-outs and residential improvements.

items.title: Hospitality
items.text: Hotel refurbishment, restaurant renovation and commercial improvement projects.

items.title: Automotive
items.text: Vehicle repair, bodywork, classic car restoration and specialist refurbishment.

items.title: Marine & Yachts
items.text: Yacht repair, refits, interior refurbishment and restoration.

scope.title: Documentation, inspection and management are different things.

cards.title: Evidence documentation
cards.text: We record and organise what is visible and reported at each milestone, so you can see progress, outstanding work and issues. It does not assess structural, mechanical, electrical or regulatory compliance.

cards.title: Independent technical inspection
cards.text: Technical inspection is carried out by suitably qualified or licensed inspectors and engineers. It is not part of our progress reports. If you need one, we can help source it under a separate arrangement.

cards.title: Project management
cards.text: Active responsibility for coordinating contractors, schedule and decisions. We provide this only under a separate written agreement that defines our role and responsibilities.
